turns.player: When did that missing patrol vanish, exactly?
turns.speaker: tavern_runner
turns.gm: Tavern Runner mutters, "Word is, that patrol’s been missing since just before dawn,."

turns.player: Where was the patrol last seen?
turns.speaker: tavern_runner
turns.gm: "From what I heard, that patrol was last seen vanishing near some muddy footprints northwest of the crates," they say cautiously, eyes darting around as if worried someone might overhear. "If you want to follow a trail, that's where I'd start."

turns.player: Why is the stew even out here in the rain?
turns.speaker: tavern_runner
turns.gm: Tavern Runner grimaces. "Not something I can say here."

turns.player: How many bowls do you have left?
turns.speaker: tavern_runner
turns.gm: "All on many is rumor: people say the ledger desk by the west pier sees the real traffic."

turns.player: What is posted on that board?
turns.speaker: tavern_runner
turns.gm: Tavern Runner grimaces. "Not something I can say here." The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.

turns.player: Alright, what does the stew cost then?
turns.speaker: tavern_runner
